description: This Java source file defines the class EntityFieldMap, which models a specific type of entity condition involving a map of field names to values. It is used to generate condition expressions based on field comparisons and join operators, primarily for building query conditions in the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityFieldMap
classes.description: A final class extending EntityConditionListBase that encapsulates a collection of conditions based on a map of field comparisons, supporting construction with various operators and providing access to internal field data.

methods.name: makeConditionList
methods.description: A private static generic method that converts a map of field entries into a list of EntityExpr condition objects using a specified comparison operator.

methods.name: EntityFieldMap
methods.description: Constructor that builds an EntityFieldMap from a variable-length list of key-value pairs, utilizing a comparison and join operator.

methods.name: EntityFieldMap
methods.description: Constructor that builds an EntityFieldMap from an existing map, applying specified comparison and join operators.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specific field name from the internal field map.

methods.name: containsField
methods.description: Checks if a specific field name exists in the internal field map.

methods.name: getFieldKeyIterator
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable iterator over the set of field names in the map.

methods.name: getFieldEntryIterator
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable iterator over the entries (field name and value pairs) in the map.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Implements the Visitor pattern for EntityCondition objects, allowing a visitor to process this EntityFieldMap.
